title: Core & waist✔️#yoga #wellness #bodygoals #shorts #absworkout
description:
✔️Activates obliques and deep core (transverse abdominis)
✔️Helps tighten the waist and reduce side-belly softness
✔️Trains core stability without crunches
🍑 Hips & glutes
✔️Strengthens glutes and hip rotators
✔️Improves hip mobility, which is crucial after 40
✔️Supports healthier hips and lower back
❤️ Fat burn & metabolism
✔️Dynamic, flowing movement = higher calorie burn
✔️Great low-impact cardio effect without jumping
✔️Boosts metabolism while toning
🧠 Coordination & balance
✔️Improves coordination between upper and lower body
✔️Trains balance and body control
✔️Helps prevent falls and stiffness as we age
🦴 Spine & posture
✔️Encourages controlled spinal rotation
✔️Builds rotational strength needed for daily activities (walking, reaching, turning)
✔️Can help reduce back stiffness when done with proper control
💪 Upper body bonus
✔️Strengthens arms, shoulders, grip
✔️Teaches the core to brace while arms move (functional strength).
Tip:
Rotate from your hips and torso, not just arms. Keep core engaged, ribs down, and move with control—not momentum💪
Don't skip this one move ‼️
